hint.title: 60-SECOND TUTORIAL
items: 1 · Expand — Select a bright powered node, then an adjacent empty point. The arrow powers the new node.
2 · Stay connected — Power flows outward from your Core. Cut an upstream node and everything beyond it becomes dim and Dormant.
3 · Attack — Target an adjacent enemy node to lock it permanently. Attacks never capture territory.
4 · Bridge — Activate Bridge, then jump exactly two spaces to an empty point. You get two; an enemy in the middle is locked.
5 · Win — Breach the enemy Core twice from two different adjacent positions. You have ten actions each.
